texts.zh:
一大批高价值实验对象借助挖掘的隧道从[root.GetName]上的一座设施内逃了出来。

这条隧道是用简陋的工具和赤裸的 [Owner.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural] 挖掘而成，必定耗费了多年时间。我们无法确定有多少人知晓它的存在，也不清楚为什么这么长时间也没人能发现。
texts.en:
A number of our valuable test subjects have fled from a facility on [root.GetName] via a makeshift escape tunnel.

Fashioned using improvised tools and bare [Owner.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural], the tunnel must have taken years to build. We cannot be sure how many knew of its existence, and how it remained undetected for so long.

texts.zh: 此类事件一再发生，需要对此做出坚决的应对以防止类似事件重演。我们此前在这一问题上的仁慈，反倒似乎成了对于剩余个体的鼓励。
texts.en: Such developments necessitate a firm response in order to prevent repeat offenses. Our previous leniency on this issue seems to have served as encouragement to the remaining population.

texts.zh: 此类事态发展需要采取坚决措施，以防止此类事件再次发生。
texts.en: Such developments necessitate a firm response in order to prevent repeat offenses.

tooltips.zh: 一半的实验对象在[root.GetName]将作为难民离开。
tooltips.en: Half of the Test Subjects on [root.GetName] will depart as refugees.

label.zh: 我们暴力的捕食天性与之抵触。
label.en: Our violent and predatory nature forbids this.

label.zh: 暂停所有运营活动，直至找到他们。
label.en: Shut down operations until we can find them.

tooltips.zh: 逃脱的实验对象将会被找回。
tooltips.en: Escaping Test Subjects will be recovered.

label.en: Execute those that remain as an example.

tooltips.zh: 将失去[root.GetName]上的所有的实验对象。
tooltips.en: All of the Test Subjects on [root.GetName] will be lost.

texts.zh:
一小队来自[RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetName]的民用飞船到达了我们的国境，其中载满了[Root.GetSpeciesName]难民。他们被准许在[Root.Planet.GetName]安家。

这些不幸的流放者被[RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetSpeciesName]帝国强迫赶走出了自己的家园。自那之后，他们便四处流浪，孤注一掷地想要在物资耗尽前找到新的家园。
texts.en:
A flotilla of civilian transports carrying [Root.GetSpeciesName] refugees from the [RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetName] have arrived in our space. They have been allowed to settle on [Root.Planet.GetName].

These unfortunate outcasts were forcefully expelled from their homes by the [RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetSpeciesName] authorities. They have been traveling from system to system since then, in a desperate attempt to find new homes before the last of their dwindling supplies were used up.

texts.zh:
一小队来自[RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetName]的破败民用飞船到达了我们的领域，其中载满了[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]难民。在我们提供了食物和医疗后，这些难民被准许在[Root.Planet.GetName]安家。

这些狼狈恐慌的难民是逃离[RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetSpeciesName]帝国肃清的幸存者。多亏了一些紧急召集起来的地面下的一伙和同情他们的商船舰长才逃了出来。
texts.en:
A battered fleet of small civilian vessels carrying [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] fleeing from the [RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetName] have arrived in our space. After we supplied them with food and provided medical attention to their wounded, the refugees were allowed to settle on [Root.Planet.GetName].

These ragged and frightened refugees are survivors from the extermination program being carried out by the [RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetSpeciesName] authorities against their species. They only made it out thanks to the efforts of a hastily organized underground railroad and a few sympathetic merchant skippers.

texts.zh:
一支的破败民船舰队，满载着逃离[RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetName]的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，已经抵达了我们的境内。在我们提供了食物和医疗后，这些难民被准许在[Root.Planet.GetName]安家。

这些狼狈恐慌的难民是[RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetSpeciesAdj]无情攻势下的幸存者。多亏他们冒险从星球上一处旧军港里偷了几艘废弃太空船才逃了出来。
texts.en:
A battered fleet of small civilian vessels carrying [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] fleeing from the [RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetName] have arrived in our space. After we supplied them with food and provided medical attention to their wounded, the refugees were allowed to settle on [Root.Planet.GetName].

These ragged and frightened refugees are survivors of onslaught carried out by the merciless [RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetSpeciesAdj] mind. They only made it out thanks to a daring theft of several decommissioned spacefaring vessels stored in an old naval yard on their planet.

texts.zh:
一支伤痕累累的民用小舰队搭载着躲避[RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetName]的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，刚刚抵达了我们的星系。在我们提供食物与医疗救援之后，避难者们获准在[Root.Planet.GetName]上安家。

这些衣衫褴褛而且惊慌不已的避难者们正在躲避[RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetSpeciesName]星系内的[RefugeeEscapedCrisis.GetName]的蹂躏。他们勉强在[RefugeeEscapedCrisis.GetSpeciesAdj]的攻势抵达其母星[RefugeeEscapedPlanet.GetName]之前仓皇逃了出来，将大部分个人财物都留在了那颗注定要覆灭的星球上。
texts.en:
A battered fleet of small civilian vessels carrying [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] fleeing from the [RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetName] have arrived in our space. After we supplied them with food and provided medical attention to their wounded, the refugees were allowed to settle on [Root.Planet.GetName].

These ragged and frightened refugees are fleeing the ravages of the [RefugeeEscapedCrisis.GetName] in [RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetSpeciesName] space. They just barely managed to escape their home planet of [RefugeeEscapedPlanet.GetName] before the [RefugeeEscapedCrisis.GetSpeciesAdj] onslaught reached it, leaving most of their personal possessions behind on the doomed world.

texts.zh: [Root.GetResearchers]已经完成了一系列以活体为对象的实验，为我们提供了许多宝贵的知识，推动了科技的进一步发展。最近的对囚犯的批量处决为[Root.GetResearchers]提供了大量实验材料，进而带来了一项技术突破。
texts.en: Our [Root.GetResearchers] have completed a series of groundbreaking experiments on live subjects, providing us with valuable knowledge that can stimulate further technological advances. The recent series of mass prisoner executions has given our [Root.GetResearchers] plenty of material for a new technological breakthrough.

texts.zh: [Root.GetResearchers]已经完成了一系列以活体为对象的实验，为我们提供了许多宝贵的知识，推动了科技的进一步发展。现在我们需要考虑在何处开展下一阶段的研究。
texts.en: Our [Root.GetResearchers] have completed a series of groundbreaking experiments on live subjects, providing us with valuable knowledge that can stimulate further technological advances. We must now consider the area in which to conduct the next phase of research.
